module: Audio settings: choice of output provider/device, per-channel volumes (master, engine, suspension, music, UI...) and stereo headphone mode. Provides the "option helpers" (get/set) used by core_settings_settings, and a function to reset to default values.
notes: The volume setters clamp the value between 0 and 1 then call Engine.Audio.setChannelVolume('AudioChannelXxx', value).

Probable BUG: in createAudioDevice, the error message uses audioProviderName which is not defined in this function (nil global variable): the concatenation would raise an error if device creation fails.
AudioEnableStereoHeadphones.set references AudioInterfaceVol and AudioAmbienceVol which do not exist in the helpers (ignored by the if test).
switchOutputDevice dumps the providers to the log and only acts on the 'FMOD' provider.

buildOptionHelpers.desc: Creates and returns (and stores) the options table. Keys: AudioProvider (get/set/getModes; set creates the audio device), AudioMasterVol, AudioPowerVol, AudioForcedInductionVol, AudioTransmissionVol, AudioSuspensionVol, AudioSurfaceVol, AudioCollisionVol, AudioAeroVol, AudioEnvironmentVol, AudioMusicVol, AudioUiVol, AudioOtherVol, AudioLfeVol, AudioIntercomVol (get reads $pref::SFX::AudioChannelXxx), AudioEnableStereoHeadphones (on change: writes $pref::SFX::enableHeadphonesMode, calls core_audio.triggerBankHotloading() and reapplies the volumes).

returns.desc: Helpers with get/set (and getModes for AudioProvider).

getOptions.desc: Returns the options table stored by buildOptionHelpers.

returns.desc: nil until buildOptionHelpers has been called.

restoreDefaults.desc: Resets all volumes to their default values: master 1.0, LFE 0.5, all others 0.8. Then settings.refreshTSState(true), settings.notifyUI() and settings.requestSave(). Requires buildOptionHelpers to have been called.

onFirstUpdateSettings.desc: Hook called at the first settings update: creates the audio device of the chosen provider ($pref::SFX::providerName), falling back to the first non-Null provider if the name is invalid.

switchOutputDevice.desc: Changes the FMOD output device: takes the device with the given index in the FMOD list of Engine.Audio.getInfo() and creates the matching audio device.

index.desc: Index in the FMOD device list.
